    | text      = Oh, that's why. So this relationship with declaring emergencies in order to seize power cannot possibly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.158
    | text      = fit with the image that Alex has presented for the rest of his career.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.859
    | text      = He's up here on his show acting like it's just how business is done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.538
    | text      = All leaders need to declare emergencies or else they can't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:33.038
    | text      = do anything because of the previous emergencies that past presidents have declared.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.339
    | text      = You need to declare emergencies, and any president who doesn't operate that way would be an idiot not to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.359
    | text      = But that's not what Alex believes, at least if you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
